component.name: Tonarc
component.summary: Privacy-first high-resolution music player and YouTube Music client

description.p: Tonarc is a privacy-first, high-performance music player built with Compose Multiplatform and Material 3 Expressive design. Play local hi-res audio files (FLAC, Opus, AAC, MP3, OGG, WAV), stream from YouTube Music with client-side Innertube resolution, view synchronized lyrics, and sculpt sound with a real-time 10-band equalizer powered by mpv.
